messages: Nina Patel: RCA posted for the runtime memory regression (2026-03-20): https://redwood-internal.docs/rcas/runtime-mem-regression-18027. Short summary: a change in v1.3.4 altered GC heuristics and led to longer-lived allocations under high-concurrency, producing elevated resident memory and latency spikes for ~40m. OpsBot: RCA doc uploaded and pinned to #postmortems. Full timeline, root cause, mitigations, and test plan inside. Alex Chen: Key action items from the RCA: 1) Emergency revert of the heuristic change 1 owner: Diego Ramos 1 target: 2026-03-21; 2) Add targeted benchmark for GC path under concurrency 1 owner: Eng Runtime 1 target: 2026-04-02; 3) SLA customer outreach template + support runbook 1 owner: Priya Nair 1 target: 2026-03-22; 4) Telemetry: add p99 resident memory and allocation-rate metric 1 owner: Observability Team 1 target: 2026-03-29. Diego Ramos: Revert PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4599 1 will coordinate fast-track review. Priya Nair: I'll prepare the customer outreach draft and post it to the doc for sign-off. Nina Patel: We'll treat the revert and telemetry work as blocking for next minor release until validated on canary. Follow-up checkpoint: 2026-03-28 11:00 PT (30m) 1 agenda: confirm revert on prod canary, validate telemetry, sign-off on outreach. Invites sent to @eng-runtime, @eng-sre, @support. OpsBot: Follow-up created and calendar invites sent. Priya Nair: Please reply with "ack" once you've read the RCA and noted owners. Nina Patel: Thanks everyone for the quick triage and owning the items. Closing thread after the follow-up checkpoint unless new items appear.
